name: Yume no Owari
source:
There is a beautiful vampire named Lark who lives in the eternity. He hates boredom and stagnation, so he goes on a journey. He stays at a village at night. But there is someone waiting for him at the village...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一个美丽的吸血鬼，名叫云雀，生活在永恒之中。他讨厌无聊和停滞，所以他踏上了旅程。晚上他住在一个村庄。但有人在村子里等着他……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
